record.what_it_does: Consensus lets you search and retrieve metadata (abstracts, citations, study type, takeaways) from over 200 million peer-reviewed academic research papers via API, MCP server, or the consumer web app.
record.auth_notes: Two separate surfaces exist: (1) the REST 'quick_search' endpoint authenticates with a static API key sent as an 'x-api-key' header (OpenAPI security scheme 'XApiKeyHeader'); enterprise/API-key access can alternatively be sent as 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY'. (2) The hosted MCP server (https://mcp.consensus.app/mcp) authenticates end users via OAuth2 (PKCE), which is what Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc. use to connect a user's own Consensus account — this is the per-user flow a multi-user agent toolkit would want, though it is documented as an MCP-client flow rather than a generic third-party OAuth app flow.
record.access_notes: The MCP search tool has a free/no-account tier (3 papers/search unlimited with no account, 10 papers/30 searches on a free signup), but the general-purpose REST API (v1/quick_search, the one a toolkit would call directly) is priced as 'now open to everyone' with a 'Create API key' self-serve button, yet included credits (500/mo) only come with Pro/Team/Enterprise plans (2,000/mo on Deep) and overage is billed at $0.05/call — no credits are described for the Free plan, and the MCP docs separately say to 'Contact Consensus for enterprise API access.' A working REST API key effectively requires a paid Consensus plan.
record.main_blocker: REST API credits require a paid Consensus plan; only a single-purpose search endpoint exists

evidence.quote: For enterprise access with unlimited rate limits, include your API key as a Bearer token
Calls are $0.05 each beyond the credits included in your plan (500 on Pro/Team/Enterprise, 2,000 on Deep)
Contact Consensus for enterprise API access at [consensus.app/home/api]
The Consensus MCP server enables AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and other MCP-compatible clients to search over 220 million peer-reviewed academic research

record.open_questions: Unclear whether the OAuth2 flow (consensus.app/oauth/authorize, PKCE) can be used by a third-party agent toolkit outside the MCP protocol to call the REST quick_search endpoint on a user's behalf, or whether it is scoped strictly to MCP client connections. Also unclear whether a Free-tier signup ever grants any REST API credits or whether a paid plan is strictly required to obtain a usable x-api-key.
